mutations.name: WAVE1 R1 anyone may create an asset
mutations.sql: alter policy assets_create on public.assets with check (true);

mutations.name: WAVE1 R2 anyone may create an episode
mutations.sql: alter policy episodes_create on public.episodes with check (true);

mutations.name: WAVE1 R3 anyone may create a shot
mutations.sql: alter policy shots_create on public.shots with check (true);

mutations.name: WAVE1 R4 anyone may create a revenue report
mutations.sql: alter policy revenue_reports_create on public.revenue_reports with check (true);

mutations.name: WAVE1 R5 anyone may create a revenue alert
mutations.sql: alter policy revenue_alerts_create on public.revenue_alerts with check (true);

mutations.name: WAVE1 R6 anyone may create a content tag
mutations.sql: alter policy content_tags_create on public.content_tags with check (true);

mutations.name: WAVE1 R7 anyone may read the account's revenue reports
mutations.sql: alter policy revenue_reports_read on public.revenue_reports using (true);

mutations.name: WAVE1 R8 anyone may read the account's content tags
mutations.sql: alter policy content_tags_read on public.content_tags using (true);
